display.purpose: Saira Stencil One — counts and section indices only, never words. Steel at rest, ink when the plane takes the light.

headline.purpose: Archivo 800 caps compressed to 82-84% width, line-height under 1. Page and section titles.

title.purpose: Archivo 800 caps at 86-88% width for panel and plate headings.

body.purpose: Archivo at natural width, sentence case, for anything addressed to the human.

label.purpose: Chivo Mono, small, tracked, uppercase — the machine's voice: timestamps, hashes, kickers, badges, filenames.

shadows.name: shadow-soft
shadows.purpose: Night shift: plates at rest in a list. Hard offset, zero blur. Day shift value: 2px 2px 0 rgba(30, 35, 40, 0.10).

shadows.name: shadow-card
shadows.purpose: Night shift: standing planes (sidebar, containers) and hover lift. Day shift value: 5px 6px 0 rgba(30, 35, 40, 0.14).

shadows.name: inset-accent-bar
shadows.purpose: Active row's painted left edge (tree rows, reply quotes).

shadows.name: focus-ring-input
shadows.purpose: Input focus tint ring paired with a rust border.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing. State transitions at 0.15-0.18s.

motion.name: bar-grow
motion.purpose: Progress/health fills draw once via transform: scaleX. Never animate width.

motion.name: lp-stamp
motion.purpose: Landing seal mark snap — the page's one authored moment.

motion.name: working
motion.purpose: Busy-button opacity pulse; sync lamp pulses the same keyframe at 1.4s.

components.name: Primary Button (Chamfered Rust)
components.description: The commitment action: cut steel with the world's signature sheared bottom-left corner.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.82rem; font-family: var(--font-archivo, 'Archivo'), sans-serif; font-stretch: 88%; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; cursor: pointer; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.72rem 1.2rem; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 10px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 10px)); line-height: 1.25; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1), background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-accent { background: var(--accent, #C9502E); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-accent:hover { background: var(--accent-deep, #C24A2A); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.99); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #C9502E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary action: transparent plate with a strong hairline border, same chamfer.
components.css: .ds-btn2 { font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.82rem; font-family: var(--font-archivo, 'Archivo'), sans-serif; font-stretch: 88%; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; border-radius: 0; padding: 0.72rem 1.2rem; clip-path: polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 10px 100%, 0 calc(100% - 10px)); line-height: 1.25; transition: transform 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1), border-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1); } .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #F2F1EC); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(242,241,236,0.30)); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--ink, #F2F1EC); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn2:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #C9502E); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Square well on the page ground; rust border plus tinted ring on focus.
components.html: <input class="ds-input" type="text" placeholder="Nombre de la obra" />
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem; font-size: 0.95rem; font-family: var(--font-archivo, 'Archivo'), sans-serif; background: var(--paper, #1E2328); color: var(--ink, #F2F1EC); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(242,241,236,0.30)); border-radius: 0; line-height: 1.35; transition: border-color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--steel, #8D979E); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent, #C9502E); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(225, 74, 31, 0.12); }

components.name: Obra Plate
components.description: Signature component: a painted-steel plate with stencil index, mono meta line, and a rust progress band inset along the bottom edge. Hover: the plane takes the raking light.
components.html: 02CASA MADEROACTUALIZADO 2026-08-12 / 14 REGISTROS / 62%
components.css: .ds-plate { display: grid; grid-template-columns: auto 1fr; column-gap: 18px; align-items: center; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #F2F1EC); padding: 16px 18px 20px; background: var(--paper-2, #2A3138); border: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(242,241,236,0.14)); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft, 2px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.30)); position: relative; overflow: hidden; transition: background 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1), box-shadow 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1); } .ds-plate:hover { background: var(--paper-3, #343C44); box-shadow: var(--shadow-card, 6px 7px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.38)); } .ds-plate-index { font-family: var(--font-stencil, 'Saira Stencil One'), sans-serif; font-size: 2.1rem; line-height: 1; color: var(--steel, #8D979E); min-width: 2ch; text-align: center; user-select: none; transition: color 0.18s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1); } .ds-plate:hover .ds-plate-index { color: var(--ink, #F2F1EC); } .ds-plate-title { display: block; font-family: var(--font-archivo, 'Archivo'), sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.05rem; font-stretch: 88%; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-plate-meta { display: block; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Chivo Mono'), monospace; font-size: 0.74rem; letter-spacing: 0.025em; color: var(--ink-soft, #C9CCC9); margin-top: 7px; } .ds-sep { opacity: 0.4; } .ds-plate-track { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 6px; background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #F2F1EC) 12%, transparent); } .ds-plate-band { position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: 0; height: 6px; background: var(--accent, #C9502E); }

components.name: State Badge
components.description: Mono uppercase state mark: tinted plane, tinted border, text label always present. Square.
components.css: .ds-badge { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Chivo Mono'), monospace; font-size: 0.62rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-badge-active { color: var(--state-active, #7fae90); background: var(--state-active-bg, rgba(127,174,144,0.14)); border: 1px solid rgba(47,125,91,0.35); } .ds-badge-archived { color: var(--steel, #8D979E); background: var(--paper-2, #2A3138); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(242,241,236,0.30)); }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.description: Panel-scoped view switch (open/resolved); the active segment inverts to ink-on-paper. Deliberately not the page-level tab grammar.
components.html: ABIERTOSRESUELTOS
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(242,241,236,0.30)); border-radius: 0; overflow: hidden; } .ds-seg-item { font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Chivo Mono'), monospace; font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.07em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 700; padding: 5px 12px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--steel, #8D979E); text-decoration: none; background: transparent; transition: background 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1), color 0.15s cubic-bezier(0.2,0.7,0.2,1); } .ds-seg-item + .ds-seg-item { border-left: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(242,241,236,0.30)); } .ds-seg-item:hover:not(.ds-is-on) { color: var(--ink, #F2F1EC); background: var(--paper-2, #2A3138); } .ds-seg-item.ds-is-on { color: var(--paper, #1E2328); background: var(--ink, #F2F1EC); }

components.name: Sync Chip
components.description: Offline-queue indicator: bordered mono chip with a 6px round pulsing rust lamp — the sanctioned round exception.
components.css: .ds-sync { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(242,241,236,0.30)); border-radius: 0; padding: 3px 10px; font-family: var(--font-mono, 'Chivo Mono'), monospace; font-size: 0.68rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: var(--ink-soft, #C9CCC9); } .ds-sync::before { content: ""; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--accent, #C9502E); animation: ds-working 1.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-working { 50% { opacity: 0.4; } }

narrative.overview:
The obra's record rendered as a precisionist industrial plate: flat, hard-edged planes under one raking light. The world refuses both the white-card/blue-accent SaaS dashboard and the blueprint-blue cliché. Every surface is painted steel — deep-slate ground, slate planes, chalk type, ash secondaries, rust paint. Nothing glows, nothing floats; the record is machinery, and it holds.

The system is theme-dual but night-native. Night shift (deep slate) is the first-run default — the client reviews the record at night — and day shift is the same site under daylight: concrete and chalk with slate ink, derived by re-aiming the identical token set. The public landing commits to night unconditionally via a scoped .lp-night token override: it is the brand surface, and the black box's native state is night.

State is carried by marks, not hues: the active plane takes the light, pending is a chalk outline, concluded is a full chalk plane, danger and progress are painted rust bands, archived is an unlit plane. The ground itself is painted canvas — flat color with a ~4% SVG-turbulence tooth and one immense hard-edged raking-light diagonal, the world's single light source made visible.
keyCharacteristics: Flat hard-edged planes; zero border radius everywhere; one chamfered corner on actions
Hard offset shadows only (the raking light) — never blurred halos
Night-native, day-derived; both shifts share one token vocabulary
Rust #C24A2A/#C9502E used as painted bands and commitments, never as ambient wash
Stencil numerals as the display device; condensed Archivo caps as signage; mono as the data voice
State grammar of marks (outline / plane / band / unlit), not color-coding alone
No emoji anywhere in the UI — monochrome SVG line icons or text only (owner rule, PRODUCT.md)

rules.name: The Marks-Not-Hues Rule
rules.body: State is a mark before it is a color: pending = chalk outline (dashed border, transparent fill, no shadow), concluded = full chalk plane, danger/progress = rust band, archived = unlit steel. A color chip alone never carries state; severity chips and badges always contain their text label.

rules.name: The Paint Ration Rule
rules.body: Rust is paint, applied in bands, edges, and stamps on commitments. It never fills a region larger than a button, and never appears as an ambient background wash.

rules.name: The Signage Compression Rule
rules.body: The bigger the type, the narrower the width: display headlines compress to 82% width, titles to 86-88%, all uppercase with tight line-height (≤1.05). Body text stays at natural width and sentence case.

rules.name: The Stencil-Is-Numerals Rule
rules.body: Saira Stencil One sets numerals only — counts, indices, section numbers — never words, never body copy.

rules.name: The Two-Voices Rule
rules.body: Anything the machine recorded (timestamps, hashes, percentages, codes, filenames, metadata) speaks in Chivo Mono at small sizes with tracking; anything addressed to the human speaks in Archivo.

rules.name: The Raking Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows are hard offset planes, never soft halos. box-shadow values carry no blur radius. Depth changes are shadow-offset changes plus one slate step — nothing floats, and nothing glows.

rules.name: The One Chamfer Rule
rules.body: Zero radius everywhere; actions alone carry one 10px chamfered corner (bottom-left). Do not chamfer non-interactive planes, and do not round anything.

rules.name: The Round Exception Rule
rules.body: Circles are reserved for period-correct hardware: indicator lamps (.pdot, .health-dot, 8-10px, border-radius: 50%) and the sync-chip's 6px pulsing lamp. These are the only curved shapes in the world, and they never grow beyond lamp scale.

dos: Do keep every surface at radius 0 and reserve the 10px bottom-left chamfer for .btn commitments only.
Do cast hard offset shadows only (2px 2px 0 at rest, 6px 7px 0 standing/hover in night) and express lift as one slate step up plus a deeper offset.
Do carry state as marks — chalk outline (pending), chalk plane (concluded), rust band (danger/progress), unlit steel (archived) — with the text label always present.
Do set all machine data (timestamps, hashes, counts, filenames, badges) in Chivo Mono at small sizes with tracking, and all display/headline type in condensed Archivo caps.
Do use Saira Stencil One for numerals only, in steel at rest, brightening to ink when its plane takes the light.
Do style native controls into the world (file pickers via ::file-selector-button, radios via accent-color) rather than replacing them with JS widgets.
Do honor both shifts: express every color through the theme tokens so day shift derives automatically; never hardcode a night hex into a component.
donts: Don't use blurred or spread shadows, glows, or halos — the raking light casts hard planes. (The appbar's backdrop blur is the one sanctioned translucency.)
Don't round anything except indicator lamps and the sync pulse; no pills, no rounded avatars, no rounded bars.
Don't let rust fill regions larger than a button or read as ambient background; it is paint on edges, bands, and stamps.
Don't use emoji anywhere in the UI — monochrome SVG line icons or text only (owner rule).
Don't carry state by hue alone; a colored dot or tint without a mark and label is not a state.
Don't revert to the retired world: no blueprint grid ground, no serif (Fraunces) voice, no white-card/blue-accent grammar.
Don't animate layout properties (width, padding); entrances use transform/opacity, hover nudges translate content.
